start: Watch paired and has sent its screen log to this phone; Help and feedback sheet open

user_sees: A switch 'Add my watch's screen log', off
Its caption on what the log holds
must_not: The switch already on
The switch on a phone with no watch log

steps.action: Turn the switch on, type 'Watch screen goes dark' and tap Send
user_sees: 'Thanks! We read every message.'
'Your watch screen log was sent too.'
The switch back off
must_not: The log sent before the message
The log sent twice

start: Profile → Settings → Help and feedback page, watch log on this phone

steps.action: Turn on 'Add my watch's screen log', type and Send
user_sees: The same two lines after sending
must_not: A different switch or words than the sheet

start: Phone that never had a MettleUp watch

steps.action: Open the Help and feedback sheet
user_sees: No watch-log switch at all
must_not: An empty or broken switch row

steps.action: Watch log on the phone, switch on, internet drops after the message went
user_sees: 'Your message was sent, but the watch screen log was not. Try again later.' in red
must_not: 'Your watch screen log was sent too.'
The message itself shown as failed

start: Switch turned on, then message send failed

user_sees: The offline line; the switch still on
must_not: The log sent without the message

steps.action: Turn the switch off, send again online
user_sees: Only 'Thanks! We read every message.'
must_not: The log sent while the switch is off

start: Watch log on this phone, sheet open

steps.action: Read the switch caption, leave it off and send
user_sees: Caption: 'It helps us fix a watch screen that goes dark. It holds only the times your watch screen turned on, off or dim, and your watch's Battery Saver and screen settings.'
Only the message is sent
must_not: The log sent with the switch off
Workouts, heart rate or other watch data in the log
